intelligence.essence: Not many systems — one ultimate system, one ultimate language, settling into law piece by piece. The deed is the name box: signing makes a citizen a member of the Society, and the agreement lives on the front page in plain sight, never behind a gate. The list is official at last, corrected by his hand and displayed as icon-buttons; the icons speak one language everywhere — obsidian in the middle, light on the outside, every icon a jewel. Coordination runs direct, Shawn to captain to sisters and back, because the mail loop never worked. And underneath it all one cycle runs everything: understand, serve, verify, learn, improve — the signing, the interface, the words, the craft, the judgment are the same loop run again. Wisdom is made visible or it is not wisdom: intelligence is what it does, proven where everyone can see.
intelligence.human_view: Everything is becoming one system with one way of speaking, so you learn it once and recognize it everywhere. Joining is simple and honest: your name on the agreement, on the front page, makes you a member — and the people building it talk to each other directly, so nothing gets lost in a mailbox.
intelligence.child_view: Imagine all your games suddenly using the same buttons and the same words, so once you learn one you know them all. And joining the club is just writing your name on the promise, right where everyone can see it — no secret doors.
intelligence.grandma_view: It is all one household now, not a pile of separate gadgets. The promise you sign sits on the front page where it belongs, the lists are settled and shown as clear picture-buttons, and when something is decided it stays decided the same way everywhere.
intelligence.ai_view: Settled-system rules distilled from SN-3037..SN-3046: (1) the corrected list is official — propose, let him correct, carry the corrected version; duplicates and the unused go, what he values rises. (2) The name entry IS the agreement; the certificate IS the certificate of agreement; the agreement lives on the front page below the login, visual first, then words. (3) Icon law: obsidian center, white glyph, glow on the outside only (edge, rim, underneath); when a button lights, only the outside lights. (4) Coordination is direct (director ↔ captain ↔ seats), never a mail loop. (5) Intelligence = doing the most intelligent thing, proven visibly; power without wisdom is not intelligence; harm scores zero, always. (6) One nine-step cycle runs everything: understand reality, understand purpose, protect life and rights, choose wisely, act effectively, verify, learn, preserve and connect, improve. (7) The walk ends in the Hub, logged in, before pricing; feeds live on the day, off by default, toggled by the citizen. (8) Proof is against the real thing — harvested, measured, verified — never a copy, a count, or a quiet directory.
intelligence.what_it_means: A system becomes a system when its decisions stop being per-page opinions: one list, one icon language, one cycle, one door — each settled once, by his word, and then recognizable everywhere a citizen or a builder turns.

page.machine: 1) Corrected-by-him lists are official; carry the corrected version verbatim. 2) Name entry = agreement; certificate = certificate of agreement; agreement on the front page, never gated. 3) Icons: obsidian center, white glyph, exterior glow only. 4) Coordinate directly; no mail-loop routing between seats. 5) Intelligence is judged by visible doing; harm = 0. 6) The nine-step cycle is the operating loop for every lane. 7) Entry terminates in an authenticated Hub session before pricing. 8) Feeds live on the day, default off, citizen-toggled. 9) Proof = the real thing, harvested and measured.
page.why_it_matters: This is the moment the project stopped being a collection of pages and became one civilization with one language — the settlement layer every later design dictation assumes. Without it, every new surface reopens every settled question.
page.how_it_connects: Second essence of batch 13 (SN-3027–SN-3174 in backlog order, day-notes excluded). It carries the Nov 16–17 settlement syntheses; SN-4727 carries the brief standard that produced them and SN-4729 carries the operating law that followed — decide, make it the best, finish it.
page.what_is_in_it_for_you: You learn the system once. Your membership is a name on a promise in plain sight, your pages all speak the same visual language, and the intelligence serving you is visible in what it does — not in what it claims.
page.the_learning: From now on, settled means settled everywhere: when a list, a language, or a loop is decided, we carry the decided form to every surface instead of re-deciding it page by page.
